serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Anyway, what’s up with Priestbot?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.StaringIntoDistance+Nun.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: Oh, him.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: He had some unfortunate encounter with the city's youth after he ran after them for talking shit.
Shanice: Now he’s in the back in need of some minor repairs, but his pride might never recover.
You: Well, I hope he’s alright.
Shanice: He is. It’s all just cosmetic. Few scratches, some graffiti.
You: If your hands are full at the moment I won’t bother you any longer. Pass my greetings to him
Shanice: I will and thanks for checking on us.
You: No problem.
